classification_rule: Each individual cast is DISCRIMINATED if a predeclared actual-caller output witness differs; RETIRED_WITH_DOMAIN_PROOF only when every member of the complete162-case domain has identical caller output bits, float32 projection dtype and exact separate projection values. No extrapolation beyond this finite domain. A projection-only difference with identical caller outputs leaves STILL_OPEN.
e288_scope: H2 synthetic geometry; representative E288 top_k8 n_group1 topk_group1 normalization and scale2.5; same bounded bias of at most1/4096 in all perturbations; no checkpoint bias inference.

mask_mutant.domain: Finite corrected scores are greater than-1e30; this sentinel excludes discarded groups in this declared domain only.

not_qualified: generalized group exclusion as production semantics
tie_policy: Output order unspecified. Mandatory strictly-above-cutoff IDs plus any required cutoff-tied IDs; no group-boundary ties. These grouped cases select both experts in the only discarded group.
